dedupe_keys.name: radars pedagogiques ville de clermont ferrand

description: Radars pédagogiques - Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in Open Data Clermont-Ferrand, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Ce jeu de données présente des données chiffrées ainsi que la géolocalisation des radars pédagogiques sur la commune de Clermont-Ferrand. Il s'agit de données brutes, c'est-à-dire non transformées et non filtrées. Coverage: Clermont-Ferrand. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are Ville à 30, Sécurité routière, Circulation, Vitesse. The portal shows 1,270 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermont-ferrand-fr-portal.
